visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with the main creator, an Asian male with short black hair wearing a black t-shirt and grey jeans with red detailing, sitting on a light-colored carpet in a modern living room. He is positioned next to a large black robotic vacuum base station. The background features white curtains, a wooden shelf with a framed picture, and several potted plants. He speaks directly to the camera with an animated expression, using hand gestures to introduce the product. (2) The creator leans forward to open the top lid of the base station, showing its internal water tanks and compartments. He then picks up a handheld cleaning attachment with a long flexible hose, demonstrating its portability. Close-up shots highlight the brand name eufy and the texture of the cleaning brush. Bright, professional indoor lighting illuminates the scene clearly. (3) The footage cuts to close-up demonstrations of the robotic vacuum cleaning brown stains from a light-colored wooden floor. The underside of the device is shown, revealing a cylindrical gray rolling mop in motion. Technical text graphics appear on screen to explain the cleaning system. Later, the creator is shown standing behind three different models of the vacuum lined up on the floor, pointing to each one to compare their designs.

He is supported by an upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop background track featuring rhythmic guitar strumming and a light drum beat. The acoustic environment is extremely clean, indicating professional studio production. (2) A distinct mechanical clicking sound is heard as the speaker interacts with the vacuum base station. The speaker's voice maintains a persuasive and friendly tone throughout the demonstration of the handheld tool. The music stays consistent in the background at a lower volume than the speech. (3) Subtle 'whoosh' sound effects are used to punctuate transitions between camera shots. A digital 'ding' sound occurs simultaneously with the appearance of technical specifications on screen. The speaker increases his vocal arousal when highlighting the suction power and cleaning efficiency. (4) In the latter half, as different models are compared, the narrator's tone becomes more analytical yet remains enthusiastic. The music continues to provide a positive and steady emotional foundation. (5) The recording concludes with the narrator summarizing the price and value proposition. The BGM maintains its tempo until a final fade out as the speaker finishes his call to action.
